sources.note: Nothing on stress/prosody or any structural feature; sociolinguistic identification only (low intelligibility with ASL/Brazilian/Argentine SLs, historical ties to Uruguayan SL). Lists the only published works: Lichtenberger 1989 Manual mímico paraguayo (first book of Paraguayan signs), 1990a Habla Conmigo, 1990b Guía lingüística y didáctica del Habla Conmigo — described as a school primer and teacher guide, i.e. pedagogical, not linguistic description.
